name: ninja-recipe-card-exporter
description: Scrape recipe cards out of Claude.ai conversations and export them as self-contained, interactive HTML recipe cards.

scripts.site: node bin/ninja-recipes.js recipes -o docs --site-title "Recipes" --link "Meal planner=planner.html" && node bin/meal-planner.js build
scripts.site:pdf: node bin/ninja-recipes.js recipes -o docs --site-title "Recipes" --link "Meal planner=planner.html" --pdf && node bin/meal-planner.js build
